name: The Royal Livingstone Hotel Victoria Falls Zambia by Anantara
insider_take: The only hotel where you can hear the thunderous roar of Victoria Falls from your room and watch elephants swim in the Zambezi River from the infinity pool.
whats_special: This historic colonial-style hotel sits just 400 meters from the edge of Victoria Falls, making it the closest luxury accommodation to one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World. The property features the world's only infinity pool overlooking the Zambezi River, where guests regularly spot elephants, hippos, and crocodiles from the pool deck. The hotel's private access to the falls means you can reach the viewpoints before the crowds arrive.
pro_tip: Book a river-facing room during full moon for the rare chance to see a "moonbow" - a nighttime rainbow created by the falls' mist under moonlight, visible only a few days each month.
dont_miss: The hotel's private railway platform where the original Royal Livingstone Express still arrives, and the guided walking safari through Mosi-oa-Tunya National Park, where you can walk alongside white rhinos and zebras with Victoria Falls as your backdrop.
pros: Prime location directly overlooking Victoria Falls
Luxury Anantara hospitality and world-class amenities
Wildlife encounters on property with zebras and giraffes roaming grounds
Exclusive access to adventure activities and falls experiences
cons: Remote African location requires international travel planning
